subject: HR controls exhibit request - Nimbus Labs SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Karen Li <karen.li@nimbuslabs.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: security@nimbuslabs.com
Date: 2026-11-12T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Request: personnel controls evidence for SOC 2 review

Hi Tessa,

As part of Nimbus Labs' SOC 2 intake this quarter, we need a compact bundle of personnel controls exhibits focusing on onboarding, training, background checks, and offboarding for the last 36 months. Specifically we are looking for: 
- training completion logs (role + course + completion date)
- background check attestations or redacted reports
- onboarding/offboarding timeline showing access provisioning/revocation
- sample chain-of-custody for evidence transfer

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether redaction/hashing is acceptable for PII? Our deadline to ingest artifacts into the SIG is 2026-11-22, so an initial package by EOD 2026-11-19 would be ideal.

Thanks,
Karen Li
Security Program Manager
Nimbus Labs
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Karen Li <karen.li@nimbuslabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-13T10:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: personnel controls evidence for SOC 2 review

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear list. We can compile a redacted bundle for you. A few clarifying points before we start: 

1) Redaction approach: do you prefer initials + hashed employee id, or fully masked IDs with a separate mapping under NDA? We typically provide initials + SHA256 of internal ID for third-party review.
2) Scope: do you want the full cohort for all employees (we can provide full dataset) or a sampled cohort (we generally share a 10% random sample plus targeted roles if asked)?
3) SSO/audit logs: you mentioned access revocation — do you want raw SSO event logs or a synthesized revocation timeline?

I'll coordinate with HR and Security to assemble: training matrix, BG attestations, onboarding/offboard CSV, and a chain-of-custody manifest. Marissa, Aditya — looping you in to help extract and redact. Targeting initial handoff to Karen on 2026-11-19 as requested.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Security Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-14T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: personnel controls evidence for SOC 2 review

Marissa / Aditya — please pull the following for Nimbus Labs (deadline 11/19):
- Training completion export (2023-11 through 2026-10): include employee role, course id, completion date. Redact PHI/PII as initials + hashed ID.
- Background check attestations: provide redacted PDFs (DOB removed, SSNs masked).
- Onboarding/offboarding timeline: CSV with provisioned services and timestamps.
- Access revocation sample: prod access revocation events for last 12 months (synthesized row-level log ok).
- Chain-of-custody manifest: who exported what, timestamps, checksums.

Use the internal redaction checklist (see link) and store mapping in the secure vault; do NOT include mapping in the package. If you hit blockers on legal redaction policy, escalate to me.

Link: https://confluence.redwood.internal/controls/redaction-checklist

Thanks — T
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-18T15:34:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: personnel controls evidence for SOC 2 review

Tessa — attaching the compiled artifacts for pre-review before we send to Nimbus: 

Attachments (stubs):
- training_completion_2023-2026.csv (csv) — 42 employee rows; name -> initials, employee_id hashed (SHA256); role, course name, completion_date.
- bg_attestations_redacted.pdf (pdf) — each attestation stamped with date; DOB/SSN removed per redaction checklist.
- onboard_offboard_timeline.csv (csv) — provisioning and deprovisioning events from HR/IDP exports.
- access_revocation_log_sample.txt (txt) — 6 sample revocation events (synthesized tokens redacted).
- chain_of_custody_manifest.pdf (pdf) — MD5 checksums and who extracted each file.

Notes:

- This package represents the full cohort (all staff in scope) rather than a sample, per your ask.
- No payroll or SSN data included. Background PDFs have been visually redacted and OCR-checked.

Drive preview: https://drive.redwood.internal/soc2/nimbus-prelim-20261118 (internal only)

If that looks good, Tessa, please push to the secure share link and send to Karen with attestation.

— Marissa
